text: The Central Sales Tax Act, 1956 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195674 Act Number: 74 Enactment Date: 1956-10-21 Act Year: 1956 Short Title: The Central Sales Tax Act, 1956 Long Title: An Act to formulate principles for determining when a sale or purchase of goods takes place in the course of inter-State trade or commerce or outside a State or in the course of import into or export from India, to provide for the levy, collection and distribution of taxes on sales of goods in the course of inter-State trade or commerce and to declare certain goods to be of special importance in inter-State trade or commerce and specify the restrictions and conditions to which State laws imposing taxes on the sale or purchase of such goods of special importance shall be subject. Department: Department of Trade & Taxes Enforcement Date: 05-01-1957 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue) Location: Delhi Notification: 5th January, 1957, all sections except
